reuse.why: Introduces one category selector for setZero and the N-month averages and routes them through the existing setNMonthAvg, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own getBudgetData filter instead of using the selector.

duplication.why: Removes three copies of the category query and the inline 3-month average, but the 'protected category' rule now exists twice: SQL in getMonthActionCategories and JS checks (hidden, group_hidden, goal_def) in copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: The selection rule and the new averaging helper live in budget/actions.ts alongside the actions that use them.

scope.why: Folding set3/6/12MonthAvg into one helper goes slightly beyond the request, though it touches only the code the rule change already had to edit.

maintainability.why: Clearer than before, but a future change to the rule must still be made in both the selector and copyPreviousMonth.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts decides hidden/group-hidden/template exclusion itself instead of using getMonthActionCategories

one_place.where: getMonthActionCategories (SQL) covers setZero and the averages; copyPreviousMonth applies the same rule separately on getBudgetData rows
